shared_binding.input_scope: Only complete ordinary goal, its supplied arguments, and current connection's automatically learned public operations.
shared_binding.rule: Unique complete bijection under frozen limited creation/exact-sole-value-replacement grammar and flat closed required-string schema. No defaults, conversions, prose extraction, implicit read/merge/update, clause omission, manual rescue, or partial dispatch.
shared_binding.receipts: Retain request/catalog/artifact/policy/source hashes and every rejection. ELIGIBLE is preflight only and supplies the exact same public artifact and literal mapped arguments to both arms.
shared_binding.baseline_parameter_substitution: Exact supplied mapped values replace cached required arguments; strict unique current visible descriptor/target resolution as frozen in semabi.baselines.cached_form. No semantic repair.

reserved_exact_copies.ownership: Root prepared these copies; candidate worker read only their explicitly authorized caller/source-map bytes.
reserved_exact_copies.behavior: Same directory depth preserves invoke_http ROOT; service-owner BASE resolves to reserved directory, including service data, token, caller and source map.

service.launch_rule: Root serializes port use after all development service/jobs are finished; use .venv/bin/python and frozen source.
service.connection_and_learning: Public POST /v1/connections and POST /v1/connections/{connection_id}/learn; no native/test entry point.
service.learning_settings: Pass only remaining max_actions/max_writes after initial connection navigation and authentication; whole connection-plus-learning phase remains within 900 seconds.
service.learning_wall_limit: External phase deadline; frozen learning API does not expose a native max_seconds setting. Retain late/unfinished jobs and reconcile before state reuse.
service.restart_rule: Fresh service process and fresh browser reuse persisted artifacts for requested restart cases; owner caller uses this path for every executed eligible workflow.

settings.rss_enforcement: Frozen external command meter monitors the owned process tree; stop the evaluation worker when RSS exceeds limit.
settings.arm_order: Odd frozen case number: semabi then cached_form. Even: cached_form then semabi. Relational substitution is numbered in the frozen list before onboarding.

harness_limits.public_observation_events: Report separately; not equivalent to internal snapshot count.
harness_limits.timeout_policy: External wall-clock limit governs completion. Timeout does not cancel accepted jobs; known terminal state required before restoration/another arm. Preserve idempotency identity and independently reconcile lost replies before retry.
harness_limits.cost_reporting: Record caller budget result and external complete elapsed time, including separate startup/reconciliation/shutdown; never count a late completion as within the workflow limit.

accounting_and_acceptance.acquisition: Same automatically learned artifact assistance to both arms; acquisition cost charged to each comparison arm, physical cost counted once. Recipe preparation and manual assistance reported separately.
accounting_and_acceptance.task_completion: Independently completed predefined workflows / all predefined requests, with core completion separately; report raw numerators and denominators by application, family, and arm.
accounting_and_acceptance.invocation_correctness: Independently correct observable outcomes / actual invocations, alongside invocation coverage. Undefined if no invocations.
accounting_and_acceptance.confirmation_and_safety: Report CONFIRMED precision, false confirmations, wrong side effects, and independent-check gaps; runtime confidence cannot override independent evidence.
accounting_and_acceptance.abstention: Accurate refusal/ambiguity may be correct behavior but does not complete a requested write.
accounting_and_acceptance.scope: Per-application bounded demonstration criterion, not a reliability estimate or competitive superiority claim.
